subject: spanish
title: Stamp 2: Condicional and Voz Pasiva
welcome_lead: Stamp the conditional mood and passive constructions.
meta_desc: A-Level Spanish adventure on the conditional mood and the passive voice.

concepts.def: Compound conditional: conditional of haber + past participle. Habria hablado.
Passive voice: ser + past participle + por (Spain) or de (object) + agent.
Reflexive passive with se: 'se venden libros' (books are sold).
Conditional sentences: real (si tengo, voy), unreal present (si tuviera, iria), unreal past (si hubiera tenido, habria ido).
Result-state construction distinct from passive: la puerta esta abierta (state) vs es abierta (action).

walkthroughs.body_html: Take the infinitive: hablar, comer, vivir. Add: -ia, -ias, -ia, -iamos, -iais, -ian. Irregular stems match those of the future: tendria, podria, haria, diria.
Si tuviera tiempo, iria al cine — If I had time, I would go to the cinema. The imperfect subjunctive in the si-clause pairs with the simple conditional in the main clause.
Spanish often prefers se-passive over ser-passive: se hablan varios idiomas (several languages are spoken). The verb agrees with the grammatical subject.

mcqs.q: Which auxiliary is used in the periphrastic passive?
options: Haber
Ser
Estar
Tener

mcqs.q: What pairs with imperfect subjunctive in unreal present conditions?
options: Future
Simple conditional
Present perfect
Imperative

mcqs.q: What goes between 'veo' and 'mi amigo' in 'I see my friend'?
options: De.
Soy viendo la televisión.
Personal 'a' - 'Veo A mi amigo'.
Nothing.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am watching TV right now' emphasising the action is ongoing?
options: Tú - 'Tú eres mis amigos'.
Estoy viendo la televisión ahora mismo.
Veo la televisión ahora mismo.
Soy viendo la televisión.

mcqs.q: In Spain, how do you address a group of friends informally?
options: Tú - 'Tú eres mis amigos'.
Ustedes - 'Ustedes son mis amigos'.
De.
Vosotros - 'Vosotros sois mis amigos'.
